race.comment: Jack Laing could not have hoped to find a better race for his first start with ANGELOTTI (12). One of the more lightly-raced horses in the race and the past two starts have been in much tougher races than this, including being beaten just two lengths at Pakenham two starts back. Joined Laing since the last run and comes here off a soft trial win, when she defeated five-time winner Rick's Cafe. The fact IMMORTAL DIVA (7) is in for second underlines the kind of race we're dealing with here. Yet to place in 17 starts, but none of them have been in a race as weak as this. Draws well and gets in well after the claim. MISS XTRAVAGANZA (8) wasn't beaten far first-up, will be better for that and has placed second-up in the past. FIGURANTE (5) has to overcome the wide gate, but can sneak a top-four finish at her best. SARAYA (9) has had more goes than most, and rises in grade on the last-start placing, but at least knows how to feature in the top-three so warrants respect.
